t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/src"; printf 'x\n' > "$t/src/a.txt"
for s in 20260101-120000 20260102-120000 20260103-120000; do BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null; done
echo "--- dry-run keep=1:"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dry-run --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep=1
echo "--- keep 1:"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 1
echo "--- remaining:"; ls "$t/dest"
echo "--- help exit:"; bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- bad --keep:"; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep x 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
rm -rf "$t"

result:
Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and new `lib/common.sh` — all 10 tests pass via `bash tests/run_tests.sh`.

Notes on what the fix involved:
- **rotate.sh**: `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which starts *at* the KEEP-th line of the oldest-first list — so with exactly N archives it deleted the newest. It now takes the first `total - keep` lines (`head -n`), guarded against BSD `head` rejecting `-n 0`. Verified live: `--keep 1` of 3 archives deletes the two oldest and keeps the newest with its sidecar.
- **verify.sh**: the sidecar line was parsed with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating names at the first space so the archive looked missing → `BAD`, exit 2. It now splits digest/name on the whitespace between them and keeps spaces in the name; digest-only sidecars are still reported `malformed sidecar`.
- **lib/common.sh**: holds the option-parsing loop and `resolve_dir` (plus `is_uint`/`need_value`); sourced from `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` after `lib/log.sh` and after each script defines `usage`/`parse_local_option`. All flags (`--dest`, `--dest=`, `--keep=N`, `-q`, `-n`, `-h`, `--`) work identically, confirmed by smoke tests. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.
- The sandbox refused to delete my temporary smoke-test script (outside the repo); if you want it gone, it's at `/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/rotate_smoke.sh`.
